## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Rome, Italy. It starts at 717 Viale dei Romagnoli.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Ostia Antica Archaeological Park is one of Italy's important historical sites, founded by Rome's King Anco Marzio in 620 B.C.
>
> Once a busy commercial center, Ostia now invites you to explore its quiet streets. With your ticket, you can discover the necropolis and 2nd-century tombs. Visit the Roman theater and see the ancient mosaics, all standing as reminders of a once-thriving society.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €20.94. It was rated 4.4 out of 5 from 135 ratings and 83 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
